about: Copied from PrompTugal__News__Website data/billing/topup.json (commit f261682c, 18 November 2026). This site has no top-up or billing page of its own yet: the meter's top-up and how-it-is-priced links point at promptugal.news, and the payment returns there, so a top-up lands in promptugal.news's browser storage, not this site's. The top-up: one payment of £5.00 on Stripe's own page, through a Stripe Payment Link. A Payment Link URL is public by design (anyone can open it, and it is printed on newsroom.sgit.ai's pages); it is not a credential. No Stripe key, webhook secret or account detail belongs in this repository, ever. Read by newsroom/build/features/billing.mjs, which puts it in the meter's config and on the top-up page. client_reference_id kept as the Website's own (web-summit-newsroom): it is the reference its payments are reconciled by, and this site does not invent a new one.
link_source: newsroom.sgit.ai, admin/build/newsroom-meter.json (topup_link), read 5 November 2026; Dinis Cruz: "It's newsroom.sgit.ai that has it all working, so grab it from there."
returns_to_source: newsroom.sgit.ai, admin/build/newsroom-meter.json (topup_link_note): the after-payment redirect set on this link in Stripe's dashboard. A Payment Link has one redirect, fixed in Stripe, so a payment started here returns to newsroom.sgit.ai's page, not this site's.
verified_why: A static page cannot verify a payment. The topped-up page adds the credit once per payment reference (Stripe's checkout session id) and cannot check it, as on newsroom.sgit.ai; building the address by hand gives credit on the reader's own screen and costs the site nothing.
our_return_source: promptugal.news's own top-up return page (not built on this site).
